Answer: 1831 (by A33)

Reasoning: Checking downward from 1839: 1839 div by 3, 1838 even, 1837=11x167, 1836 even, 1835 div by 5, 1834 even, 1833 div by 3, 1832 even. 1831 is prime (not divisible by any prime up to sqrt(1831)~42.8).
